sources.title: GitHub - PascalAI2024/qwen38-27b-quant-bench: Independent KL-divergence ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a 27.32B dense vision-language model with a hybrid Gated DeltaNet / attention architecture. The published GGUF ladders stop at IQ2_XXS (~9.0 GB). This repo pushes below that, and — more usefully — measures which knobs actually matter when the constraint is 16 GB of VRAM rather than raw model quality.
